title: Google gives Gemini the ability to use your Mac for you

claims.claim: Google, Perşembe günü macOS üzerindeki Gemini masaüstü uygulamasına bilgisayar kullanımı (computer use) özelliği getirdiğini duyurdu.

evidence.quote: Google on Thursday announced that it is bringing computer use to its Gemini desktop application on macOS
Starting today, computer use in the Gemini app for Mac helps you get multi-step tasks done across your local files, desktop apps, and the web.

Google on Thursday announced that it is bringing computer use to its Gemini desktop application on macOS, allowing its AI to complete tasks on users’ behalf, navigating native Mac apps, and browsing websites in the background.

claims.claim: Google, Eylül ayında ailelerin e-posta, takvim, sohbet ve görevler konusunda organize olmasına yardımcı olmak için tasarlanan yenilenmiş CC AI ajanını duyurdu.

evidence.quote: Google also only recently began admitting early testers to try its revamped “CC” AI agent, announced in September, which is designed to help families stay organized across email, calendars, chats, and tasks.

claims.claim: Özellik başlangıçta ABD'de İngilizce olarak sunulmaktadır.

evidence.quote: The feature is initially available in English in the U.S.
Computer use is rolling out in English in the U.S. in the Gemini app for Mac.

claims.claim: Özellik, Mac için Gemini uygulamasını ve bir Google AI Plus, Pro veya Ultra aboneliğini gerektirir.

evidence.quote: requires the Gemini app for Mac and a Google AI Plus, Pro, or Ultra subscription.
The feature is initially available in English in the U.S. and requires the Gemini app for Mac and a Google AI Plus, Pro, or Ultra subscription.
